title: Chief Future Officer: Mandy Fields, e.l.f. Beauty
description:
Chief Financial Officers now play a critical role in shaping corporate strategy and positioning organizations to meet future challenges. This episode profiles e.l.f. Beauty CFO Mandy Fields, who has helped lead the cosmetics company to 30 consecutive quarters of net sales growth. Bolstered by the purchase of Hailey Bieber's Rhode brand, e.l.f. now sees skincare as a path to even stronger long-term success.

Chapters:
00:00:00 -  e.l.f. Beauty’s disruptive growth
00:02:10 - Culture as a strategic advantage
00:03:20 - Skincare, acquisitions and growth
00:05:03 - Pricing, tariffs and the consumer
00:07:22 - Global expansion and marketing
00:10:28 - Mandy Fields’ path to CFO
00:12:29 - Innovation and product strategy
00:17:50 - AI, inclusivity and e.l.f.’s future
